title: Make address required and add zoom controls with location pins to community map

requirements.text: Make the address field required in the SetCoordinatesDialog component on the community map page so users cannot submit without providing their address

quotes: make address a required field in the community map page

acceptanceCriteria: Address field in SetCoordinatesDialog has required validation
Form cannot be submitted without an address value
User sees validation feedback if they attempt to submit without an address

requirements.text: Add zoom in and zoom out controls to the GlobeMap component so users can control the camera distance to the globe

quotes: make the globe be able to zoom in and out

acceptanceCriteria: Zoom in button increases camera proximity to globe
Zoom out button decreases camera proximity from globe
Zoom controls are visible and accessible on the GlobeMap
Appropriate min/max zoom limits are enforced

requirements.text: Display user locations with visible pin markers on the globe in the GlobeMap component showing where users live based on their addresses

quotes: show where users live with pins

acceptanceCriteria: Pin markers are clearly visible on the globe at user location coordinates
Each pin represents a user's location based on their address
Pins are distinguishable from the globe surface
Pins maintain proper 3D positioning when globe is rotated or zoomed

constraints: Preserve existing Three.js globe rendering implementation
Maintain compatibility with current address-based location system
Keep existing hover and selection interactions for user profiles
nonGoals: Changing backend schema or UserProfile structure
Modifying geocoding logic or address validation
Altering profile setup or profile page functionality
Adding real-time location updates or tracking
